title: Truchas 2D thermal model
description: The physical model and boundary/source data for 2D heat transfer. Material conductivity and enthalpy properties come from the selected materials; this object supplies the boundary conditions and optional source terms.

stefan-boltzmann.description: Stefan-Boltzmann constant used by radiation boundary conditions. The default is 5.67e-8 in the input unit system.

absolute-zero.description: Absolute-zero temperature offset used by radiation boundary conditions. The default is zero in the input temperature scale.

temperature-from-enthalpy.description: Controls the root-finding recovery used when converting enthalpy density back to temperature.

bc.description: Named thermal boundary conditions. The definitions must collectively cover every mesh boundary face exactly as required by the simulation.

temperature-tolerance.description: Absolute temperature tolerance for the enthalpy inversion. The default is zero.

bracket-initial-step.description: Initial temperature increment used to expand a failed root bracket. The default is 1e-3.

bracket-max-tries.description: Maximum number of bracket-expansion attempts. The default is 50; zero disables recovery attempts.
